note: Audit shards for council mode audit. Excluded files are never sent. Any other file belongs to the first shard whose paths match ('**' crosses directories, '*' does not); 'rest' takes every file no shard claims. Each shard is split into parts of at most 70000 characters. See docs/council/SETUP.md.

Every other file not excluded above
